This is a very interesting thing to notice. It means that animals slowly fit themselves or adapt themselves to their surround. They change their colour to protect themselves from their enemies as they cannot easily be seen if they are the same colour as their surroundings. It is difficult to see the tiger in the thick jungle. This very interesting fact that animals try to fit in with their surroundings is a very important thing. Of course animals do not themselves try to change. But those which change and therefore fit in with their surroundings have a better chance of living.
